dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: Ah... A "manifestation" of "contingency." I see it emerging from the "falling" of "Dasein."

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: Good. You are sharp to have caught that word.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: "Contingency" implies an unpredictable future and potential, and to possess potential is to possess hope.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: That is what the Saint told us back then. But unfortunately, shortly after I arrived here, the possibilities he held vanished into thin air.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: Just as you heard, I'm chanting the words I can still remember over and over, until they are granted meaning once again through the practice of language...

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: Or until I feel satisfied. At least for now, I feel quite alright.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: It's alright. That which is unspeakable can only be left unspoken.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't quite catch that, but it feels somewhat sad...

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: It is indeed a tragedy... but such is history. Like language, history is fluid. Just as words have no fixed referents.

dialogues.speaker: Tosalis
dialogues.text: So the words themselves do not matter. What matters is that we have reached an understanding. One could certainly call this a successful conversation.
